def slugify(title):
    """Transform a string into a slug."""
    # Convert to lowercase
    title = title.lower()
    # Remove non-alphanumeric characters except spaces
    title = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", "", title)
    # Replace spaces with hyphens
    slug = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", title)
    # Keep leading and trailing hyphens if they exist
    if title.startswith(' '):
        slug = '-' + slug
    if title.endswith(' '):
        slug = slug + '-'
    return slug
"}

{"path":"slug.py","content":"import re

def slugify(title):
    """Transform a string into a slug."""
    # Convert to lowercase
    title = title.lower()
    # Remove non-alphanumeric characters except spaces
    title = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", "", title)
    # Trim leading and trailing spaces
    title = title.strip()
    # Replace spaces with hyphens
    slug = re.sub(r"\s+", "-", title)
    return slug
"}
